rationale.conceptual: The task requires applying spin-polarized DFT with supercells, substitutional doping, oxygen vacancies, and FM/AFM energy differences; it's a well-established non-trivial method but not novel or custom.
rationale.execution: Multi-stage pipeline involving structure generation, geometry optimization, SCF calculations for magnetic moments, and separate FM/AFM runs for two-Ti configurations; moderate orchestration and parsing needed but standard tools and no fragile data acquisition.

difficulty.reasoning: Standard DFT calculations on small supercells for magnetic properties; moderate conceptual difficulty due to spin-polarized calculations and multiple doping configurations; moderate execution due to pipeline of many relaxation/SCF runs with careful output extraction; small computational needs (CPU-only, low memory).

compute_estimate.reasoning: Small supercell (40 atoms) DFT calculations with moderate plane-wave cutoff and k-point mesh; CPU-only, modest memory (~4 GB per job, sequential execution).
